description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions in the OpenClaw project, including age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry points, and log file selection.

classes.name: UtilitiesTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that groups utility-related test cases for OpenClaw.

methods.name: age strings cover common windows
methods.description: Tests the 'age' function for formatting time differences in a human-readable way.

methods.name: parse SSH target supports user port and defaults
methods.description: Verifies parsing of SSH target strings with various formats, including user, host, and port.

methods.name: sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix
methods.description: Ensures that the SSH target string is correctly sanitized by removing prefixes and defaults.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin
methods.description: Checks that the gateway entry point prioritizes the 'dist' directory over 'bin'.

methods.name: log locator picks newest log file
methods.description: Tests that the log locator correctly identifies the most recent log file based on modification date.

methods.name: gateway entrypoint nil when missing
methods.description: Ensures the gateway entry point returns nil when no suitable file is found.
